fiction.title: BIG LITTLE TRUTHS
fiction.author: Liane Moriarty
fiction.description: In a sequel to “Big Little Lies,” a stranger’s presence at a school may force things to the fore that had not been shared.

fiction.title: THE CALAMITY CLUB
fiction.author: Kathryn Stockett
fiction.description: As things get tougher during the Depression, several women look for ways to improve their circumstances.

fiction.title: YESTERYEAR
fiction.author: Caro Claire Burke
fiction.description: Natalie Heller Mills, a privileged tradwife social media influencer, wakes up to find she is living in the comparatively difficult reality of 1855.

fiction.title: WHISTLER
fiction.author: Ann Patchett
fiction.description: Decades after their time together, a woman reconnects with her stepfather and they look back at the directions their lives have taken.

fiction.title: HEART OF GLASS
fiction.author: Jennifer Hillier
fiction.description: When a man known as the Carnival Killer takes back his confession, two women who lost their friend 25 years ago must confront their past.

nonfiction.title: GOING FURTHER
nonfiction.author: Ted Cruz
nonfiction.description: The Republican senator from Texas profiles the Supreme Court justice Clarence Thomas.

nonfiction.title: REGIME CHANGE
nonfiction.author: Maggie Haberman and Jonathan Swan
nonfiction.description: Two White House correspondents for The New York Times delve into the first year of President Trump's second term.

nonfiction.title: STAR OF THE SHOW
nonfiction.author: Dolly Parton with Tom Roland
nonfiction.description: Stories and photographs documenting the late country music icon’s career onstage.

nonfiction.title: THE RISE AND FALL OF THE ARTIFICIAL STATE
nonfiction.author: Jill Lepore
nonfiction.description: The author of “These Truths” examines how technology and artificial intelligence have impacted global democracy and human community.

nonfiction.title: THE SERVICEBERRY
nonfiction.author: Robin Wall Kimmerer
nonfiction.description: The author of “Braiding Sweetgrass” illuminates how the gift economy in the natural world works and draws lessons for our economy; with illustrations by John Burgoyne.
